status: Frozen after outcome-free target identity/state/structure audit and aggregate release-summary inspection; no row-level OPV target outcome has been read.
purpose: Test whether experimental optical knowledge learned outside the photovoltaic literature improves prediction of sparsely labelled, DOI-disjoint and molecular-scaffold-OOD organic photovoltaic devices.
scientific_hypothesis: A donor/acceptor optical property card learned from an independent spectroscopy database constrains light harvesting and excited-state energetics that are incompletely recoverable from a small photovoltaic recipient set. Benefit should concentrate where recipient labels are chemically distant but both device molecules retain support in the optical source.
claim_guard: A positive result establishes one retrospective experimental-database borrowing edge from molecular optical spectroscopy to organic photovoltaic device prediction. It does not prove universal optoelectronic transfer, prospective device discovery, or benefit when device state is unavailable.

strict_exclusions: every exact canonical donor or acceptor molecule in the OPV recipient
every DOI present in the OPV recipient
every source task failing grouped out-of-fold skill
source.lookup_upper_bound: A source model retaining exact target molecules is descriptive only and cannot satisfy the primary gate.

target.declared_grain: one literature-mined single-junction OPV device record with donor and acceptor molecular structures
target.aggregate_information_inspected_before_f: The public release manifest reports tier counts and aggregate field coverage, including aggregate outcome summaries. No row-level target outcome was opened.

outcome_free_audit.source_qualification: donor and acceptor self-host-solid source support are each at least 0.20 after all exact target molecules are excluded

split_and_ood.external_holdout: A DOI is external when the first eight hexadecimal digits of SHA256(normalized DOI), interpreted as an integer, are divisible by five.
split_and_ood.sampling_unit: one deterministic representative device record per unique development DOI and donor-acceptor pair, sampled without target outcomes
split_and_ood.evaluation_pool: all records from external DOI groups; no external DOI can contribute a labelled target record
split_and_ood.target_distance: geometric mean of donor and acceptor maximum Morgan-Tanimoto similarity to the labelled target molecules in their corresponding device roles
split_and_ood.primary_scope: the 40 percent of source-qualified external records with the lowest target-distance score
secondary_scopes: double-scaffold-OOD records for which neither donor nor acceptor scaffold is represented in labelled target data
split_and_ood.grouping: DOI is the inferential resampling unit; donor and acceptor scaffold membership is reported and used for OOD diagnostics

recipient_features.molecular: Separate radius-2 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints for donor and acceptor.
recipient_features.state_encoding: Training-only frequency-limited one-hot categories with an other/missing level plus robust-scaled numeric variables.
forbidden_primary_features: article title, journal, author or citation count
recipient_features.target_energy_upper_bound: Target-database HOMO/LUMO annotations may be evaluated only as a labelled target-side property upper bound, never as external borrowing.

borrowed_feature_card.construction: For donor and acceptor separately, ensemble means and standard deviations of every admitted source property are combined with signed differences, absolute differences and products for matched properties.
controls: same-dimensional card from source-label-permuted self-host-solid models
column-permuted real card within target role
borrowed_feature_card.support_use: Source support is supplied to the model and is also used to define the frozen qualified scope; it cannot be tuned from target outcomes.

models.seed_pairing: Every method uses the same target-label draw and learner seed.
models.physics_recombination: A secondary PCE prediction is computed as predicted Voc times predicted Jsc times predicted FF divided by 100; the directly fitted PCE remains primary.

inference.primary_contrast: state-aware plus real solid optical card versus state-aware target-only
specificity_contrasts: real solid optical card versus shuffled-source card
real solid optical card versus state-blind optical card
real solid optical card versus permuted-real card
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction over the four named primary-family contrasts at the primary budget and scope

leakage_sentinels: Target outcome columns are not read during metadata audit, source exclusion, source training, feature construction, DOI splitting or label-draw generation.
No exact target molecule or target DOI remains in strict source training.
No external DOI enters target training.
All rows sharing a DOI remain in the same external/development partition.
Source task admission uses source outcomes only.
Target-database energy annotations are absent from every primary design matrix.
All real, shuffled and random cards have identical row membership and declared dimensionality.
Positive, null, harmful and abstaining results are archived without replacement.

compute.balam: one full node with four GPU allocation units and 64 CPU workers; source Chemprop training uses one GPU at a time and recipient repeats use CPU workers
compute.checkpointing: source scope, repeat and label budget checkpoints keyed by design, source, target archive and metadata hashes
compute.network: all public data are packaged before compute-node execution
